about.text: Q8: embodied carbon A1-A3 summed per storey, with the mean energy use intensity. Elements is every element on the storey; ElementsWithValue is how many have an embodied-carbon row (Q7). On Roof, 7 of 8 elements have a value; the roof itself has none, so the Roof sum covers only those 7.

perStorey.aggregates: count(*) as Elements, count(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as ElementsWithValue, sum(EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e) as EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e, avg(EnergyUseIntensity_kWh_per_m2_year) as MeanEui_kWh_per_m2_year
